clue.text: Newspaper logo is a modern phenomenon

definitions.meaning: taken literally, the masthead emblem of The Times newspaper
an idiom for something typical of the present day

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for a trend typical of its age, and read literally it is the emblem of The Times newspaper.

clue.text: Display notice cancelling the performance

definitions.meaning: to flaunt or parade, used as a verb
a playbill announcement that the show is off

explanation.definitionFit: To flaunt is a colloquial verb meaning parade one's talents, and a sign saying the show is off would cancel a performance.

clue.text: Be reprimanded-for having a cold shower?

definitions.meaning: an idiom for landing in trouble
said ironically: a cold shower is the opposite of stepping into a hot bath

explanation.surface: Someone is told off for taking a cold shower.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is ironic: the question mark warns that a cold shower is exactly what this is not.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means landing in trouble, and literally entering heated bathwater, the reverse of a cold shower.

clue.text: Former student going to a northern resort

parts.note: OB stands for Old Boy, a former pupil of a school

explanation.surface: An old boy heads off to a seaside town in the north.
explanation.walkthrough: OBAN is a seaside town on the west coast of Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Oban is a Scottish coastal town popular with holidaymakers, so an example of a resort.

clue.text: Religious belief is found in other people

indicators.note: being found in something means sitting inside it, so one piece is placed within another

parts.note: THEM is the pronoun for other people

explanation.surface: Faith is something you see in other folk.
explanation.definitionFit: Belief in a god or gods is the core meaning of this religious term.

clue.text: Tomb in the end was given its epitaph

indicators.note: the tomb word is placed inside the word for the end

parts.note: END is a plain synonym for the end
a grave is a tomb

explanation.surface: In the end a tomb had its memorial inscription carved.
explanation.definitionFit: A headstone's inscription is carved into it, so a tomb given its epitaph has been cut with letters.

clue.text: Vulgar show featuring English apprentice

indicators.note: a show featuring something holds it within, so the other letters go inside

parts.note: to indicate is to show
L is a learner, as on a British learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A coarse performance stars an English trainee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Show' looks like a noun but is the verb, and 'featuring' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Something vulgar is coarse and lacking in good taste or propriety.

clue.text: Choose right, and one urban copper will make current charge

parts.note: to elect is to choose
I is the Roman numeral one
city is used as an adjective, as in city life
the Bill is British slang for the police, a copper being a policeman

explanation.surface: Picking the right person and a city policeman will bring a fresh accusation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'current' is electric current and 'charge' the amount billed, not an accusation now pending.
explanation.definitionFit: The bill from the power company is what you are charged for the current you use.

clue.text: International body is about to reach agreement

parts.note: UN is the United Nations
on means about, as in a talk on a subject

explanation.surface: The United Nations is set to reach a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in harmony means acting in concord, together as one.

clue.text: Silver in unconventional setting is an abomination

indicators.note: silver is set inside the word for unconventional

parts.note: outre means eccentric or unconventional
AG is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Silver jewellery in a bizarre mount is a horror.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setting' suggests jewellery, but the container signal is 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: An outrage is a shocking, wicked act, which is what an abomination is.

clue.text: Pin used to catch a fish

definitions.meaning: a pivot pin, as in the piston pin of an engine
a small freshwater fish often used as bait

explanation.definitionFit: A pivot pin joining piston and connecting rod has this name, as does a small carp-family fish used as bait.

clue.text: Has a peculiar son

parts.note: own in the sense of peculiar or particular to someone

explanation.surface: Someone has an odd boy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'peculiar' means strange on the surface but particular here, as in 'peculiar to'.
explanation.definitionFit: To possess something is to have it.

clue.text: Realises it represents the Jews

indicators.note: to re-present is to present again in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone realises what the thing stands for.
explanation.definitionFit: Israelites are the people of ancient Israel, the Hebrews of the Bible.

clue.text: Tasteful additions in shanties round

indicators.note: the shanties go round the other word, holding it inside

parts.note: sea songs are what sailors' shanties are

explanation.surface: Tasteful touches appear in a round of sea songs.
explanation.definitionFit: Salt, pepper and spices are added to food to bring out its flavour.

clue.text: Pick a note further down the scale

parts.note: F is one of the notes of the musical scale
lower means further down

explanation.surface: Choose a note lower in pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pick' means the best, as in 'the pick of the bunch', and so does 'the flower of'.
explanation.definitionFit: The choicest part of something is called its flower, as in 'the flower of youth'.

clue.text: Response to engineers strike

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers of the British Army
industrial action is a strike

explanation.surface: A reply to engineers walking out.
explanation.definitionFit: A reaction is a reply or answer prompted by something.

clue.text: Am upset and unhappy about the flag's position

indicators.note: in a down clue upset turns the word upside down, so it is read upwards
the word for unhappy goes about the next word, holding it inside

parts.note: sad means unhappy

explanation.surface: Someone is upset and unhappy about where the flag flies.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'upset' turns its word upside down; 'about' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: A flag flies at the top of the pole, the masthead on a ship.

clue.text: Paper hat for a dunce

definitions.meaning: a large size of writing paper
the conical cap a slow pupil once had to wear

explanation.definitionFit: It names a large size of writing sheet and, split, the cap a jester or dunce wears.

clue.text: Glad rags are just the thing on the railway

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece on another sits above it

parts.note: fine means excellent, just right
RY is the abbreviation for railway

explanation.surface: Smart clothes are perfect on the trains.
explanation.walkthrough: GLAD RAGS is British slang for one's best clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Finery is showy, elegant clothing worn for a special occasion.

clue.text: A fabric produced to order

parts.note: twill is a woven fabric with diagonal ribs

explanation.surface: A cloth made to a customer's specification.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something whenever one wishes is doing it on demand, as one chooses.

clue.text: Let Tory organisation hold a raffle

indicators.note: organising is putting in order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Allow the Conservative Party to run a prize draw.
explanation.definitionFit: A raffle is a draw of tickets where prizes go by chance.

clue.text: A growth in emergency stocks

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of letters across these two words

explanation.surface: A tumour turns up in the reserve supplies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' points to the letters spanning emergenCY STocks.

clue.text: Opposed to article on Italian uprising

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece on another sits above it

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the word reads upwards

parts.note: IT is short for Italian, as in Italian vermouth

explanation.surface: Against an item about an Italian revolt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uprising' turns IT to TI, under AN.
explanation.definitionFit: Being against something means being in opposition to it.

clue.text: Train one in tenure transaction

indicators.note: a deal changes things over, so the letters of the holding are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Coach someone in a property deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Train' is the followers of a dignitary, not coaching. 'transaction' shuffles TENURE with I placed in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A dignitary's train is the group of attendants following behind.

clue.text: Imprison cheat and add monetary penalty

parts.note: to con is to swindle or cheat
a fine is a penalty paid in money

explanation.surface: Lock up a swindler and also make him pay.
explanation.definitionFit: To confine someone is to shut them in, as in a cell.

clue.text: Quiet inhabitant needs one friend-like head of state

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
a resident is an inhabitant
I is the Roman numeral one
an ally is a friend

explanation.surface: A quiet local needs a companion who is like a national leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'friend-like' looks like one word but splits: 'friend' gives ALLY and 'like head of state' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means in the manner of a president, the elected leader of a republic.
